lines.text: Previously. The sky cracked open over the crossing in Nerima, and I fell into another world.
lines.tts: Previously. The sky cracked open over the crossing in Neh-ree-mah, and I fell into another world.

lines.text: I pulled an axe out of a grave that nobody could move for three hundred years.
A girl named Nemu died to protect me. And something inside the axe asked me what I wanted to break.
lines.tts: A girl named Neh-moo died to protect me. And something inside the axe asked me what I wanted to break.

lines.text: I told it. Everything that's in the way.
You're not sleeping, boy.
Neither are you, apparently.
I slept for three hundred years. I'm catching up on being awake.
Can everyone hear you?
Only you. Lucky boy.
Talking to your axe again?
It started it.
Get some sleep. Ashford's half a day's walk, and the Guild doesn't like people who show up yawning.
Five more minutes...
You've been asleep for six hours.
Then five more hours.
So this is a town.
I was expecting more... dragons.
Dragons are more of a southern thing.
That was a joke.
So was mine. Mostly.
Is that the Headsman's Axe? On that boy's shoulder?
Can't be. Nobody could pull it out.
Look at his hair. Is he one of the Ashveils?
Everyone's staring.
You're carrying a legend around like a bag of groceries.
It's heavy. Where else am I supposed to put it?
Most people would put it in a museum.
Skewers! Fresh skewers! Rift-boar, still warm!
Takuto.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: No.
I died for you yesterday.
...How many?
Four. For now.
I don't even have money. I have two hundred yen and a receipt for cat food.
Is that silver? Those little coins? I'll take 'em!
...Four skewers, please.
Mm. Rift-boar.
What's a Rift-boar?
Don't ask while you're chewing.
Sieg. The Guild. What happens there?
lines.tts: Seeg. The Guild. What happens there?

lines.text: Registration. They test your Brand, give you a rank, put your name in a very big book.
Ranks go from F to S. F means you can carry luggage. S means kingdoms send you letters.
And you?
A. Kingdoms send me invoices.
Do they have records? Of Skyfallen?
...Some.
My friend disappeared at that crossing two years ago. Haruki. Same crossing. Same bell.
lines.tts: My friend disappeared at that crossing two years ago. Hah-roo-kee. Same crossing. Same bell.

lines.text: If something like me fell through, maybe he did too.
Then you ask the Guild. I'm not the one who keeps that book.
...He changed the subject.
I noticed.
The Hunters' Guild of Ashford. Try not to break anything.
I only break things on purpose.
That's what worries me.
Welcome to the Hunters' Guild of Ashford! Registration, quests, or complaints?
Registration. Two of them.
Wonderful! Names, please.
Nemu. Just Nemu.
lines.tts: Neh-moo. Just Neh-moo.

lines.text: Kirishima Takuto.
lines.tts: Kee-ree-shee-mah Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: Kiri... shima? What an unusual name. Where are you from, sir?
Nerima.
lines.tts: Neh-ree-mah.

lines.text: I don't know where that is.
He's Skyfallen.
...Oh. Oh. I see.
We have a form for that. It's a very long form.
Of course you do.
And your weapon, sir? We register those too. Please place it on the counter.
Are you sure? It is a little heavy.
Sir, I've weighed war hammers. I think I can handle an a...
Is that the Headsman's Axe?
People keep asking me that.
It was in the Barrow Fields! For three hundred years! We have a painting of it! In the lobby!
It was loose.
He keeps saying that.
I need to get the appraiser. Please don't move. Please don't put it down. Please don't pick it up either.
Should I just hold it?
Hold it very calmly!
Did someone say... the Headsman's Axe?
Valentine. Brand appraiser of the Ashford chapter. And this is Tofu.
The cube is called Tofu?
He is white, he is square, and he does not like being dropped. What else would I call him?
Fair.
Tofu reads Brands. The mark on your soul has a shape, a weight, a color. He measures all three.
Then he gives you a rank, and you spend the rest of your life complaining about it.
Ladies first. Little cat, step forward.
I'm not little.
Tofu, if you please.
Nine Lives. Rank D. Lives remaining... two.
Two? Darling, what have you been doing?
Dying, mostly.
We're going to talk about that later.
You're making the face.
And now, our Skyfallen woodcutter. Hold the axe. Breathe. Think of something you hate.
Paperwork.
Perfect.
Tofu?
Error?
Tofu does not say error. Tofu has never said error. Tofu once appraised a dragon.
Maybe the cube is broken.
Wash your mouth, Sieg Valen.
lines.tts: Wash your mouth, Seeg Valen.

lines.text: The Brand is called Ruinbreaker. That much he could read. The rank, the limits, the ceiling... nothing.
Either your Brand is broken, little woodcutter, or it is bigger than the box we built to measure it.
Bigger. Obviously.
Shut up.
...I beg your pardon?
Not you.
Oh, I like him. I like him very much. Register him as unranked, and put a star next to his name.
We don't have a star.
Draw one!
All of these are jobs?
Fiend bounties. Lesser ones pay in copper. Greater ones pay in silver.
And the ones with the red seal?
Calamity class. Those pay in gold, and funerals.
What was the thing at the crossing?
A Shieldbearer is Lesser. The weakest kind.
That was the weakest kind?
Mm. You're going to have a very interesting life.
This one. The big one with the horns. Morvudd?
Don't take that one.
I wasn't going to. I was just reading it.
Then stop reading it.
...Sorry. Old poster. Bad memories. Come on, the clerk has your star ready.
Four times.
I'm keeping count.
Which one of you is the Skyfallen with the Headsman's Axe?
Why do you have my hair?
Why do you have mine?
Wait. Are those two siblings?
They have the same face when they're angry.
We are NOT related.
Agreed. My sister is nicer.
You have a sister?
No.
He does that.
Rin Ashveil. C rank, the youngest in the chapter. She has been waiting three years for someone to pull that axe out.
lines.tts: Rin Ash-vale. C rank, the youngest in the chapter. She has been waiting three years for someone to pull that axe out.

lines.text: Four years. I was going to pull it out. I trained for it. I had a plan.
It was loose.
It was NOT loose! I tried every morning! I tried with rope! I tried with my Brand!
She tried with a horse once. The horse gave up first.
Valentine!
Fine. You want to be a Hunter? Then prove the axe chose you. Training yard. Now.
I'm not fighting a girl over an axe.
Good. You won't be fighting. You'll be losing.
Sieg?
lines.tts: Seeg?

lines.text: Go on. You need to learn what your Brand can and cannot do. Better from her than from a Fiend.
I'll hold the skewers.
They're my skewers.
Were.
Rules. No killing, no maiming, no damage to the Guild walls. Valentine is still angry about last spring.
Eleven thousand crowns of stonework!
Draw your axe, Skyfallen.
It's always drawn. It doesn't fit in a pocket.
Begin!
Red Thread.
...What is this?
My Brand. Every thread I tie moves with me. Pull, and you fall. Struggle, and you choke.
Threads. How adorable. Break them.
Ruinbreaker.
He... cut them? No. He broke them.
You swing like a landslide.
Thanks.
It wasn't a compliment. Landslides are slow.
Block this.
Ha! Didn't anyone tell you?
I don't defend, boy. I only destroy.
Yield.
...I yield.
You hit like a landslide, and you defend like a sheet of paper.
Whatever that axe is, it isn't yours yet.
Are you dead?
Only my pride.
That one doesn't come back. Trust me.
I tried to block. The axe just... wouldn't. It slid off her knife like it didn't want to.
Because it didn't want to, darling.
Every Brand has a price. Nine Lives has a count. Afterimage has a delay. Red Thread snaps if she loses her focus.
Ruinbreaker breaks anything it strikes with intent. Shields. Armor. Barriers. Other Brands.
And in exchange, it will never, ever stand between you and a blow.
So I can only attack.
So you have to be faster than everything that wants to hit you. Or smarter.
I'm neither.
Not yet.
In three days the Guild holds its licensing exam in the Bramble Wastes. Teams of two. Survive, and you're a Hunter.
Teams. Then Nemu and I...
lines.tts: Teams. Then Neh-moo and I...

lines.text: Ah. About that. Teams are assigned by the appraiser. Rank with rank, gap with gap.
And the only applicant this season who might survive standing next to an ERROR...
No.
Is a certain C rank with very red threads.
Absolutely not.
ABSOLUTELY NOT!
She heard that from across the yard.
Ha! This is going to be a wonderful exam.
Again. When I swing, you move. Not your axe. You.
I moved last time.
You moved your eyebrows. That is not dodging.
Afterimage.
Two swings. You swung twice.
Once. My Brand swings the second time for me, a heartbeat later, from the same angle.
Everyone you fight will have a trick like that. You can't block it. So you read it.
How?
Watch the shoulders, not the blade. The blade lies. The shoulders never do.
You sound like a fortune cookie.
I don't know what that is, but I'm choosing to be flattered.
Sieg. Is he getting better?
lines.tts: Seeg. Is he getting better?

lines.text: He's getting hit less. That's the same thing, at the start.
Why are you helping me?
Because a long time ago, somebody taught me the same thing, and I didn't listen.
What happened?
...Again. From the top.
He changed the subject.
Three times today.
You brought me a boy with the Headsman's Axe and didn't warn me.
Would you have believed me?
I'd have worn a better coat.
Sieg. Do you know why that axe was in a grave?
lines.tts: Seeg. Do you know why that axe was in a grave?

lines.text: The stories say the Headsman buried it with himself.
The stories are polite. The Guild archive is not. Three hundred years ago, something called the Crimson Calamity burned four cities to the ground.
The Headsman didn't kill it. He couldn't. So he sealed it, into the only thing he owned that could hold it.
His axe.
And today, while Tofu was reading that boy's Brand, something inside it looked back at him.
...He talks to it. He thinks we don't notice.
Then watch him, Sieg Valen. Very closely. If that thing ever opens its eyes...
lines.tts: Then watch him, Seeg Valen. Very closely. If that thing ever opens its eyes...

lines.text: I know what the Guild does with Branded who lose control.
Vesper does it. Let's make sure she never has to.
Again, Takuto! Shoulders, not the blade!
lines.tts: Again, Tah-koo-toh! Shoulders, not the blade!

lines.text: You're still mad.
I'm not mad. I'm practicing.
You're practicing being mad.
...My brother was a Hunter. B rank. He used to walk me out to the Barrow Fields to look at that axe.
He said whoever pulled it out would be strong enough to protect everyone. He said it like a fairy tale.
What happened to him?
A Greater Fiend, four years ago. The day after, I started trying to pull out the axe. Every morning.
And then some idiot from another world walks past and it just... comes out. Like it was waiting for him.
Maybe it was.
That's not comforting.
It wasn't meant to be. He's an idiot, but he jumped in front of a Fiend for me yesterday. And for a cat, the day before.
...For a cat?
Mm. He's that kind of idiot.
...I'm still going to beat him at the exam.
You're on his team.
Then I'll beat him from the same team.
The book. The one with every Hunter's name in it. Does it have Skyfallen too?
It does, sir. But the Skyfallen pages are... sealed.
Sealed by who?
By order of Saint Lumen. The capital. Every Skyfallen is reported there, and the pages come back with a gold seal on them.
I'm looking for one person. Shinjo Haruki. Sixteen. Black hair. He'd have come through about two years ago.
lines.tts: I'm looking for one person. Sheen-joh Hah-roo-kee. Sixteen. Black hair. He'd have come through about two years ago.

lines.text: I'm sorry, sir. I'm not allowed to break the seal.
She isn't. I, however, have terrible manners.
Tofu has a very good memory. He reads every Brand that passes through this hall. Including, two winters ago...
A boy with black hair and blue eyes. Frightened, polite, very cold hands. His Brand stopped Tofu's clock for three seconds.
That's him. Where did he go?
Where every Skyfallen goes. A carriage came from Saint Lumen, with a golden sun on the door. He got in. He waved.
That is all I know, and I have already said too much in a building with very thin walls.
Thank you.
Don't thank me. Pass the exam. Hunters can go anywhere. Even the capital.
Can't sleep?
It's too quiet. In Nerima there's always a train somewhere.
lines.tts: It's too quiet. In Neh-ree-mah there's always a train somewhere.

lines.text: You miss it.
I miss the cat. The rest of it I can live without.
Liar.
...Maybe.
The boy on the poster. Haruki.
lines.tts: The boy on the poster. Hah-roo-kee.

lines.text: You saw that?
I fell on it. It was very soggy.
He fed that cat every night on his way home. Then one night he didn't come home.
Everyone said he ran away. I didn't believe them. I kept going to the crossing.
And then the sky opened, and I thought... oh. Oh, that's where he went.
And if he's here?
Then I find him. And I take him home.
...Sieg changed the subject again, didn't he. When you asked about going home.
lines.tts: ...Seeg changed the subject again, didn't he. When you asked about going home.

lines.text: Twice.
Then don't ask him. Ask me. I'll tell you the truth.
...Has anyone ever gone back?
Go to sleep, Takuto.
lines.tts: Go to sleep, Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: That's an answer, isn't it.
It's a suggestion. You have an exam in three days and a partner who hates you.
Don't remind me.
Three hundred years in the dirt, and you're my first friend in centuries.
We're not friends.
Not yet, boy. Not yet.
Ruinbreaker.
...Let's see what it breaks first.
Next time: the licensing exam in the Bramble Wastes.
I'm stuck on a team with Rin, I meet a guy whose head is on fire who says he's from Osaka...
...and the ground starts walking.
Episode three. A Flame From Home.
